en.headline: The Gruffalo plays its last Hong Kong dates this weekend
en.dek: The 60-minute English-language stage show, based on the picture book, continues at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts through Sunday.
body: The stage adaptation of Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler’s picture book The Gruffalo has its final Hong Kong performances this weekend at the Rita Tong Liu Drama Theatre of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts in Wan Chai.

ABA Productions, Tall Stories of the United Kingdom and CDP Kids Productions of Australia are presenting the hour-long show, which is performed in English with no interval. The academy lists remaining performances on Saturday and Sunday at 11am, 2pm and 4.30pm. The production is aimed at children aged three and above; every audience member needs a ticket.

Tickets are sold through Cityline at HK$475, HK$425, HK$375 and HK$275 for restricted-view seats. The run opened on 4 September and was billed as marking 25 years of the stage version. Organisers have said weekend seats have been limited.

zh.headline: 音樂劇《古飛樂》本周末演藝學院煞科
zh.dek: 改編自繪本的一小時英語演出，周六及周日在灣仔香港演藝學院廖湯慧靈戲劇院尚有場次。
body: 改編自朱莉亞・唐納森與阿克塞爾・舍夫勒繪本的舞台劇《古飛樂》（The Gruffalo），本周末在灣仔香港演藝學院廖湯慧靈戲劇院迎來本輪最後場次。
演出由ABA Productions、英國Tall Stories及澳洲CDP Kids Productions聯合呈獻，全場約60分鐘、不設中場休息，以英語演出。演藝學院公布周六及周日尚有上午11時、下午2時及4時30分場次。節目以3歲或以上兒童及家長為對象，所有入場人士均須持票。
門票經Cityline發售，票價475、425、375及275港元（視線受阻座位）。本輪由9月4日起演出，主辦方指舞台版今年踏入25年，周末門票較緊紐。
